Nominal IPE and horizontal HEA flange width b is placed along out-of-plane X; section height h is placed in the elevation plane by the rigid member placement. For the five HEA200 verticals, the source shows nominal flange width b=200 mm in the elevation plane, so section height h=190 mm is placed along out-of-plane X.
